title: Send feedback
lead: Suggest improvements, report a problem, request a new engine or ask a question.

bug.name: Report a bug
bug.hint: Something doesn't work as you expected
bug.titlePlaceholder: E.g.: The editor closes when exporting to Excel
bug.placeholder: What you did, what you expected to happen and what happened. If there was an error message, copy it.

enhancement.name: Suggest an improvement
enhancement.hint: An idea to make DBine better
enhancement.titlePlaceholder: E.g.: Being able to pin columns in the results grid
enhancement.placeholder: What you would like DBine to do and how it would help you.

driver-request.name: Request a new engine
driver-request.hint: A database DBine doesn't support yet
driver-request.placeholder: How you use this engine and what you would need first: explore, query, edit data, migrate…

question.name: Ask a question
question.hint: How to do something in DBine
question.titlePlaceholder: E.g.: How do I compare two databases?
question.placeholder: What you want to do and what you tried.

diagnosticsNever: This is everything that is included. Never servers, users, database or connection names, queries or passwords.
truncated: The description is too long to send in full: it will be cut off. You can complete it on GitHub before creating the issue.
publicNote: GitHub opens with everything filled in: you just have to click “Create”. You need a GitHub account. The issue is public: don't include private data.

done.title: GitHub opened in your browser.
done.text: Review what was filled in and click “Create” to publish it. Thanks for helping us improve DBine!
